0a88b318-cbaf-41a4-b836-a19e87c5ad19.name: Reanimate
rules: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. You lose life equal to its mana value.

760fcb0a-85c1-4510-bd0c-5bcf39eea4df.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
